title: Zesty Charred Algerian Lamb Tagine
description: A hearty and aromatic North African stew featuring tender lamb in a rich and spicy sauce, charred to perfection with high heat cooking oil and infused with dashi extract for added depth of flavor.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425 degrees Fahrenheit.
Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over high heat until it reaches 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Add the lamb cubes and sear until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the dashi extract, cumin, smoked paprika, cayenne pepper, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it starts to caramelize, about 5 minutes.
Add the chopped garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the diced tomatoes and stir to combine.
Cover the Dutch oven and transfer it to the preheated oven.
Bake for 30 minutes, then reduce the heat to 375 degrees Fahrenheit and continue baking for an additional 20 minutes.
Remove the tagine from the oven and let it cool slightly before serving.
